# SCOT

Toolbox for single cell RNA-seq

## Installation

You can install the development version of SCOT from
[GitHub](https://github.com/CCBR/SCOT) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("CCBR/SCOT", dependences = TRUE)
```

## Usage

Take a look at the [reference
documentation](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/index.html) for
detailed information on each function in the package.

## Help & Contributing

Come across a **bug**? Open an
[issue](https://github.com/CCBR/SCOT/issues) and include a minimal
reproducible example.

Have a **question**? Ask it in
[discussions](https://github.com/CCBR/SCOT/discussions).

Want to **contribute** to this project? Check out the [contributing
guidelines](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/CONTRIBUTING.md).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_VDJ_metadata()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/add_VDJ_metadata.md)
  : add_VDJ_metadata: Appends V(D)J alignments from CellRanger to an
  existing Seurat object
- [`calc_sc_gsea_score()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/calc_sc_gsea_score.md)
  : calc_sc_gsea_score: Calculates scores for pre-ranked GSEA
- [`cluster_metrics()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/cluster_metrics.md)
  : cluster_metrics: Calculates clustering metric scores
- [`convert_human_gene_list()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/convert_human_gene_list.md)
  : convert_human_gene_list
- [`convert_mtx_to_h5()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/convert_mtx_to_h5.md)
  : convert_mtx_to_h5: Converts the triple .mtx files from single cell
  experiments to a .h5 counts file
- [`fetch_celldex_ref()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/fetch_celldex_ref.md)
  : fetch_celldex_ref: Helper function to import annotation references
  from celldex
- [`filter_doublets()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/filter_doublets.md)
  : filter_doublets: Identifies and removes doublets or multiplets in
  scRNA samples
- [`make_bubble_plot()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/make_bubble_plot.md)
  : make_bubble_plot: Flexible dotplot
- [`make_volcano_plot()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/make_volcano_plot.md)
  : make_volcano_plot: Optimized volcano plot for Seurat differential
  expression (FindMarkers) output
- [`preprocess_sample()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/preprocess_sample.md)
  : preprocess_sample: Performs an initial preprocess on a Seurat object
- [`run_AUCell()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/run_AUCell.md)
  : run_AUCell: A wrapper script for running AUCell for per cell gene
  set enrichment analysis
- [`run_batch_correction()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/run_batch_correction.md)
  : run_batch_correction: Performs batch correction within Seurat v5
  framework
- [`run_hypergeometric_test()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/run_hypergeometric_test.md)
  : run_hypergeometric_test: Calculates the p-value of an
  overrepresentation test using the hypergeometric test
- [`run_singleR()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/run_singleR.md)
  : run_singleR: Runs SingleR directly on the Seurat object
- [`run_singleR_cluster()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/run_singleR_cluster.md)
  : run_singleR_cluster: Runs SingleR on average expression of clusters
- [`run_singleR_db()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/run_singleR_db.md)
  : run_singleR_db: Runs SingleR with the built-in databases from
  celldex
- [`seurat_clustering()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/seurat_clustering.md)
  : seurat_clustering: A quick end-to-end clustering of a Seurat object
- [`split_featurePlot()`](https://ccbr.github.io/SCOT/reference/split_featurePlot.md)
  : split_featurePlot: Splits FeaturePlot by groups
